Partner studioEstudio aliado

Conceptual Furniture

Conceptual Furniture is our partner studio, with a store in Colombia. For furnishing projects we source pieces through them. Sofas, dining, chairs and accent pieces are selected for each home and coordinated by our studio from order to delivery.Conceptual Furniture es nuestro estudio aliado, con tienda en Colombia. Para los proyectos de mobiliario seleccionamos piezas a través de ellos. Sofás, comedores, sillas y piezas decorativas se eligen para cada hogar y nuestro estudio coordina todo, del pedido a la entrega.
